about.headline: Your ally to scale with technology
about.body: Make it Easy is your strategic partner in automation and systems integration. We don’t replace people — we make your team more productive by connecting ERPs, CRMs, and automation tools so your organisation operates at its best.
about.mission: To empower human talent in every organisation by integrating their systems and automating the operational, so people can focus on what’s strategic.
about.vision: To be the go-to technology ally for businesses that want to scale by connecting their ERPs, CRMs, and processes with AI.
about.diff1_body: Every workflow is designed for your operations. We integrate with your ERP, CRM, or current system.
about.diff2_body: We work with organisations worldwide, remotely and without friction.
about.diff3_body: Diagnosis, integration, automation, and support — all from one ally.
about.diff4_body: We don’t eliminate positions: we free your team from repetitive work so they create more value.
about.diff5_body: Every project includes clear KPIs that prove the productivity impact.

services.headline: Impact Areas
services.s1_body: Massive lead sync, automated qualification and prospect nurturing through conversational AI agents.
services.s2_body: Real-time tracking, intelligent inventory management and automatic delivery route optimisation.
services.s3_body: Automatic bank reconciliation, mass electronic invoicing and real-time profitability reports.
services.s4_body: Design and implementation of custom AI workflows with n8n, Make, Zapier and language models.
services.s5_body: ERP, CRM and external platform connections. High-performance interface development.
services.s6_body: Automation of contracts, approval workflows and document management with full traceability.
services.s7_body: Practical training programmes for business teams on AI tools and automation.

process.headline: 360° Process
process.sub: A proven method to make your team more productive, step by step.
process.s1_body: We map your current processes and systems (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets) to find where you can save time. Always free.
process.s2_body: We design the ideal integration and automation architecture for your current tools.
process.s3_body: We deploy automations and integrations without disrupting your operations. Your team keeps working while we improve everything.
process.s4_body: We constantly optimise your workflows and support your team to get the most from every tool. 24/7.

services_pricing.headline: Find your solution
services_pricing.sub: We don't sell fixed packages. Every project is unique and priced according to your process. Prices in {currency}.

services_pricing.note: Free initial diagnosis, no commitment required.
services_pricing.s1_q: Is your team spending time answering the same questions over and over?
services_pricing.s1_body: We build an AI agent that supports your team by handling customer interactions via WhatsApp, web, or social media — 24/7. It answers questions, books appointments, takes orders, and frees your people for higher-value tasks.
services_pricing.s2_q: Want customers to find you and trust you from the very first click?
services_pricing.s2_body: We design fast, modern websites optimised to convert visitors into customers. Landing pages, corporate sites, or online stores. SEO included.
services_pricing.s3_q: Is your team spending hours on operational tasks instead of strategic work?
services_pricing.s3_body: We automate the repetitive by connecting your tools (ERPs, CRMs, spreadsheets) so your team becomes more productive: reports, emails, alerts, follow-ups, and more.
services_pricing.s4_q: Is your sales team losing opportunities due to lack of follow-up?
services_pricing.s4_body: We implement and automate your CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, or others) so your team sells more with less effort: leads, follow-up, reminders, and smart pipelines.
services_pricing.s5_q: Are your ERP, CRM, and systems disconnected, wasting your team's time copying data?
services_pricing.s5_body: We integrate your ERP (SAP, Odoo, NetSuite), CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce), e-commerce, and any platform so data flows automatically and your team works with unified information.
services_pricing.s6_q: Making decisions without clear data because gathering it takes hours?
services_pricing.s6_body: We build real-time visual dashboards so you see the pulse of your business at a glance: sales, operations, finance, and more.
services_pricing.s7_q: Does your team want to use AI but doesn't know where to start?
services_pricing.s7_body: We train your team with practical, custom workshops on AI tools, automation, and productivity. No jargon — straight to what works.
services_pricing.s8_q: Do you need a specific tool that doesn't exist in the market?
services_pricing.s8_body: We develop fully customized software solutions that adapt 100% to your business logic and specific needs.
services_pricing.s9_q: Are your internal processes a mess and you don't know where to start automating?
services_pricing.s9_body: We analyze the current architecture of your business, identify bottlenecks, and design optimized workflows ready to scale.

team.headline: The people behind the automation
team.sub: Three founders, one mission: making technology work for people.
team.daniel_bio: Environmental Engineer and Productivity Management specialist, Daniel combines the analytical rigour of engineering with a disruptive vision of technology. With a solid background as a Project Manager and expertise in automation and "vibe coding", he leads Make It Easy with a clear purpose: to redesign the operational architecture of organisations so that technology works for people, not the other way around. His approach goes beyond automating tasks — he optimises entire business ecosystems through AI and n8n.
team.cristian_bio: Digital strategist and developer focused on turning ideas into robust systems. Cristian specialises in custom software architecture and integrations that connect every piece of a business. With mastery of programming and automation, he designs digital infrastructures where efficiency is the priority. His approach combines technical logic and strategic vision to create fluid, scalable digital experiences oriented towards real results.
team.luis_bio: Industrial Engineer with a comprehensive vision in process optimisation and commercial development. Luis specialises in diagnosing and structuring the backbone of organisations, ensuring every operational flow is aligned with growth objectives. His approach combines industrial efficiency with strong commercial execution, translating technology into profitability. He is the bridge between process strategy and effective market expansion.
